item.title: 0.6.3-beta.1
item.description:
# Agent HUD 0.6.3-beta.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- Speaks nine languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Pick one in Settings → General → Language, or let it follow the system. - Adds "Take me around" to the card that tells what an update adds. It starts the getting-started tour beside the HUD, and the card counts as read. - Reads Qoder, QoderWork, TRAE, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, ZCode and MiniMax Code accounts from each app's own sign-in. Each region is its own account: Qoder CN, TRAE CN and CodeBuddy CN show apart from the international ones. - Lets agents start DeepSeek Harness sessions, through Agent HUD's plugin in a running Harness. With none running, the Harness desktop app opens. - Lets an agent that reads the answer itself leave out the reply line (#75). With `reply_hint: false` on `send_message` or `start_session`, the message ends by asking the recipient to answer in its turn, instead of sending a message back. - Opens the windows a sign-in page asks for beside the sign-in window, and presents the system's own browser to the site, so sign-ins that open a second window or check the browser go through.
### Fixes
- Delivers agent messages to Antigravity on Windows (#77). Finding Antigravity's server took over 6 seconds on some computers, longer than a message may wait, so every message was refused. It now takes milliseconds. - Stops marking CodeBuddy, Qoder CN and QoderWork as "Requests only" on the Remote page; their conversations sync to the phone too.

# Agent HUD 0.6.13
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- The panel's footer says when the numbers were last read ("Read just now", "Last read 5m ago") and has a button that reads every agent again, so a reading after a Claude chat shows without waiting (#135). Each vendor's own spacing between reads still applies. - The auto-hide bar keeps the colour you chose, and usage shows as a soft glow round it, as round the notch: each agent's colour by its level, breathing faster while one works, flashing on alerts (#140). Settings → Display has its own Auto-hide section with a switch for the glow. - `list_sent_messages` lists the messages the calling session has already sent, newest first, so an agent whose send timed out can check before sending again (#92, #151, thanks @zqy5618). - A send whose `to` and `reply_to` name different sessions is refused with a reason, and a message's label names the sender's session (#150, thanks @zqy5618). - Windows: Antigravity's local service now works on Windows. `list_models`, Antigravity sessions in `list_sessions`, starting a session, sending, answering its approvals and interrupting all work there. - Windows: Agent HUD finds the installed Codex, Antigravity and DeepSeek Harness desktop apps, so sessions can be started in them.
### Fixes
- With Rings or Segments, an agent billed by balance only, such as DeepSeek, gets an empty track ring, so its icon and spacing match its neighbours. In Simple mode its balance is written short (¥5.37, ¥105, ¥1.2k); the panel keeps the full amount (#137). - The Mac no longer counts an iPhone, or its Apple Watch, that has not written for three days when it checks whether every device is new enough to read its data. An old record of a reinstalled iPhone made the iPhone warn that "another iPhone and Apple Watch" needed updating (#138); the iPhone's own side of the fix comes in a later iPhone update. - A card's text that wraps one more line no longer hides under its buttons, and a request's long detail scrolls inside the card past 150 points, so Deny and Allow stay in view. - Windows: DeepSeek Harness sessions that are running now appear in `list_sessions` and take `send_message`, by session ID or by `reply_to`, even when they are not in the last 24 hours' index. `.jsonl.zstd` logs are read, and `DSH_HOME` may start with `~` (#164). - Windows: Settings no longer shows DeepSeek Harness, which needs no hooks, as not supported. - Windows: Cursor, TRAE, WorkBuddy, Qoder, ZCode and Kimi Code no longer claim they can take messages on Windows, where their hooks don't run yet. `list_sessions`, sending and the client pages now say the same. - Windows: Agent HUD now checks whether a Claude Code, Pi or OpenCode process still runs, so a session whose process ended no longer stays as it last was. - A reply to a conversation in ChatGPT desktop's Work mode finds its sender, so an Antigravity answer reaches it (#155). If the sender is not in the session list, the reply goes to the Codex thread recorded with the original message, but only while that thread exists and is not archived or deleted. - A Codex session started through `start_session` runs at the reasoning effort set in Codex's config, not at medium (#153).
